sections.text:
Domain Knowledge
Excellent payments domain knowledge comprising of high value payment market infrastructure, funds transfer and liquidity management, working with both SWIFT and ISO20022 messages
SME in Payments Transformation and ISO20022 Migration • Product SME of Payment Processing System Global Payplus and VolPay • Have worked extensively on the various categories of SWIFT messages that includes Customer Credit Transfers (MT 102, 102+, 103, 103+), Financial Institution Credit Transfers (MT 202, MT 204), Collection and Cash Letters (MT 400), Debit and Credit Advices (MT900, MT910), Sender Notification (MT 012) and Abort Notification (MT 019)
Thorough understanding of SWIFTNet which provides a platform for the exchange of real-time messages using XML standards (Inter ACT) and the exchange of bulk messages e.g. non-urgent and low value payments (File ACT) • Excellent technical proficiency and hands-on working experience on Finastra’s (Fundtech’s) Global Payplus (GPP)
Proficient knowledge and experience of SWIFT CBPR+ SEPA and UK’s FPS. • Worked in Interest Rates, Credit, Foreign Exchange, Commodities and Equities class in the Capital Markets Domain
Working knowledge of collateral and valuation reporting of OTC derivatives • Working knowledge of automation tools like RIT and cucumber • Working knowledge of MiFID II trade and transaction reporting for cash equities
